content.short: Larix is Solana's metaverse-based protocol featuring a dynamic rate model and capital-efficient risk management pools.
content.description: Larix is Solana's first Metaverse-based protocol, featuring a dynamic interest rate model and capital-efficient risk management pools designed to adapt to changing market conditions. This architecture enables secure use of a broad spectrum of collateral types, including crypto tokens, stablecoins, synthetic assets, NFTs, and other assets, all while maintaining sound risk controls. The reward system, built on a carefully constructed token economy, enables continuous incentive allocation to increase demand.
